{{Quote|Still, the data chip appears to have survived intact. Cause for ''celebration'', I think you'll agree.|[[Unidentified Neimoidian councilor|A Neimoidian councilor]], to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Update">{{TCWComicCite|6.53|Update}}</ref>}}
A '''datachip''', also spelled as '''data chip''', was a device which was encoded with data.

==History==
Coded datachips were used by security forces to control the [[Lock/Legends|locks]] used on [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Scientist/Legends|Scientist]] [[Toval Seyah]] created a datachip encoded with data to destroy [[Centerpoint Station]].
